title: 2D Modern day Military Textures
description: The Modern day Military textures Texture-Pack, offers a new perspective on some of the classic MC tools and armor, adecuating them to a more modernized style.
body: ![The new armor models: Leather(Still dyeable), Chainmail - Guillie Suit, Iron(helmet-fryingpan), Golden -Hazmat Suit, Diamond-Heavy (2plates + Kevlar)(Helmet-Ballistic Helmet) and Netherite-Special Ops suit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d51d2c4c14998554ffc37d94a975d3021a1484a_0.webp)With this texturepack I tried to ease the use of gun mods (like TACZ or any other) by changing the look of the vanillla armor and tools, from a medieval one, to something more moddern looking. I have also included a few new looks for items like the totem of udying, trident, shield, golden carrots, gapples and egapples.
